$comment: Template for prod_vms.json. One row per VM — the number of rows IS the topology: 1 row = the single-node profile, 4 rows (M1 M2 M3 O1) = the v1 ship-now deck, 7 rows = the v2 target with M1 M2 M3 drained (see 'v1 baseline' in PROD_VM_PROVISIONING.md section 1). Every node that must run workloads carries the label role=worker, never role=manager: a node holds one value per label key, and fourteen services pin node.labels.role == worker, so role=manager leaves them all unschedulable. A node's swarm role belongs in the role field below, which is what docker reports; a node label is for placement only. prod_node_check.py --inventory prod_vms.json must exit 0 before any deploy.
